variants.headline: Looking back: builder signs for a new project
variants.sub: A construction contract for {project} has been awarded to {builder}.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The builder {builder} had signed a contract for {project}.

An award defines a commercial undertaking, not earned revenue for all work or a finished asset for the client. Managers should distinguish contract value from execution. The agreed price is material, but it does not by itself settle the questions of performance that a building agreement necessarily leaves to delivery.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We welcome {target} in this assessment. A definite agreement to build deserves recognition as a practical step, while a fair account can distinguish that step from the obligations still to be fulfilled.
